ResearchProjectDef.label: blacksight device
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that allows the user to temporarily partially shift into the void. The implant is crafted from modified noctolith sensors, using archotech shards to control the phase mechanisms. The user can activate the device, causing them to move and attack far faster in darkness. However, the inverse is true in light. While active, the user is unthreatened by unnatural darkness.

ResearchProjectDef.label: alkalicoat implant
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that grants its user immunity to acid. The implant is crafted from the archite stomach lining that prevents devourers from digesting themselves and maintained by the influence of an archotech shard. By implanting a thin layer of these archites between the dermal layers, the user gains immunity to acid damage, and cannot be digested.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deadlife coil
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that makes the user far stronger as a shambler, and revives them as one upon death. The implant consists of a strange archo-organ surrounded by twisting bioferrite pipes and uses an archotech shard at it's core to maintain and supercharge any deadlife archites present in the user’s body.

ResearchProjectDef.label: retributive impaler
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that is formed of hundreds of telescopic, subdermally implanted bioferrite quills and connected to implanted nerves. The implant is crafted from harvested gorehulk nervous systems, using an archotech shard to safely fuse with the user. The retractable spines extend from the user's flesh to impale those who harm them in melee range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: dreadheart
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a bio-mechanical organ that allows the user to temporarily gain impossible regeneration. The implant is crafted from a modified dreadmeld core, using archotech shards to control the growth mechanisms. The user can unbind the functions of the core, causing new flesh to sprout in place of their wounds. However, if used too frequently, there's a chance of the regeneration going rampant, incapacitating the user as huge masses of flesh sprout from their body, becoming fleshbeasts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ghoul power plating
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture reinforced bioferrite armor with neural assistors for surgical attachment to vulnerable areas. It significantly reduces incoming damage but still slows movement. Only ghouls can tolerate the installation's extreme pain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hyper-adrenaline gland
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that enhances the speed and pain resistance of the user after taking damage. The implant is crafted from the archotechnological adrenal glands of a chimera, using an archotech shard to stimulate the release procedure. By pumping a combination of synthetic superadrenaline and archites into the bloodstream, the user is able to move much faster and ignore their pain for a period of time after recieving enough damage. Unfortunately, the presence of hyper-adrenaline in the body boosts aggression levels, leading to increased chances of social fights.

ResearchProjectDef.label: metalhorror symbiont
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that enhances the combative capabilities of its host. The implant is crafted from the archometallic seed of a metalhorror, using an archotech shard to control and manipulate the growth of the creature. The symbiont’s metallic filaments weave through the host’s body, forming a second musculature system and the metalblood flowing through the host’s veins hardens in response to physical trauma. Due to the symbiont’s presence, any attempt by other metalhorrors to colonise the host will be rapidly destroyed. Upon death, the mechanisms that slave the metalhorror to the host will fail, allowing it to immediately tear free of the corpse.

ResearchProjectDef.label: psychic agonizer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that allows the user to project a pulse of pure mental pain. The implant is crafted from a modified nociosphere emitter, using archotech shards to harness its psychic capabilities. The user can release a wave of psychic agony, briefly incapacitating all creatures nearby. However, while the user is in pain, the implant also constantly causes a feedback loop of psychic pain to all creatures that spend too much time in the user's presence.

ResearchProjectDef.label: psychic beguiler
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that allows the user to enthrall another person. The implant is crafted from a modified golden cube, using archotech shards to control its psychic influence. The user radiates an aura of perfection and beauty, enhanced by their psychic sensitivity, and gains the ability to focus this psychic field into the mind of another, rapidly captivating and luring them into the user's faction. The victim will always feel strong positive emotions for the beguiler but will enter a berserk rage when they die.

ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that sustains the user during meditation and psychic rituals. The implant uses dark archotechnology to allow its user to tap into the ambient psychic field of a distant archotech, enabling to enter a psychic trance that sustains their body.

ResearchProjectDef.label: slayer's collar
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an implant that allows its user escape death by causing it. The implant is formed of a ring of jagged, chaotic void metal and uses an archotech shard to flay a corpse of it's lingering psychic energy. After murdering 50 humanoids, the collar gains enough psychic energy to produce a seed of death refusal archites.
Slayers collars serve as a symbol of eternal servitude among worshippers of Horax.
